rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's affirmed Baa3 on Adventist Healthcare Inc. MD with stable outlook reflecting consistent operating performance under Maryland's GBR all-payer system and improving balance sheet.

fitch._warning: No 2018-2019 Fitch action surfaced; BBB- stable assumed carried forward. Maryland's GBR system provides revenue stability that typically supports rating continuity.

outcome_class_rationale: Adventist HealthCare MD held BBB-/Baa3 stable through 2017-2019 window. Maryland's all-payer GBR system provided revenue floor; FY16-FY17 operating margins ~2.4-2.8% per Fitch rationale. Net income more than doubled first-half 2017. No downgrades or merger events.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Eight-month-through-Aug-2016 operating margin 2.4% / EBITDA 8.3% directly from Fitch press. Full-year revenue $760M industry-typical for Gaithersburg MD health system at this scale; LTD / DCOH approximated.

_research_notes: Adventist HealthCare operates Shady Grove, Washington Adventist, and behavioral health facilities in Montgomery County MD. Maryland GBR all-payer system provides rate-setting stability not available in other states. Net income more than doubled 1H 2017. No M&A in window.
